summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new consultant→client e-contract signature-request flow. Verified: (1) '署名を依頼' button on client Contracts list posts /send-important and moves DRAFT→IMPORTANT_INFO_SENT; (2) 'リマインド' button on list & detail posts /remind, returns {ok:true, kind:...}, status unchanged for both IMPORTANT_INFO_SENT and CONTRACT_SENT; (3) client confirm() auto-issues agreement in a single step (IMPORTANT_INFO_SENT → CONTRACT_SENT) and the recipient sign card is immediately shown; (4) full happy-path CONSULTING flow reaches ACTIVE. All 10 new backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend UI actions verified via Playwright (real API calls to backend, correct toast messages, correct data-testids present).

minor.issue: In backend/tests/test_econtracts_flow.py TestAFlow test_05/test_06 assert FIRST_PARTY_SIGNED after FINORA_SAAS consultant sign but backend has always executed _auto_issuer_sign() (line 593-594 of econtract.py) that jumps to ACTIVE. This is a stale assertion in the older test — NOT related to this feature. Pre-existing bug in the test, not the code.

New /remind endpoint is properly gated by is_issuer, rejects unsupported statuses with 409, and includes audit logging. Correct.
EContractPanel.jsx correctly hides sign-request button for client role and for FINORA_SAAS type (onSignReq is null). Correct.
EContractDetail.jsx IssuerTools shows ec-send-important with label ec_request_signature for CONSULTING and ec_send_important for FINORA_SAAS — matches spec.
Row button label switches DRAFT→'ec_request_signature' vs otherwise→'ec_remind' as required.
